mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against zero mean return.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 index level, sustained for two months, indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO remains below 90.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 217.0 with a 3-month momentum exceeding 0.5% per month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing real rates, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 217.0 with 3-month momentum > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized increase in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates robust aggregate demand expansion, which strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a labor market contraction, which increases recession fears and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000 and UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock coupled with weak labor demand, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 92.0 and UNRATE > 9.0%.
